public_rationale: Marcus forecast that in 2029 AI will not be able to reliably build bug-free code of more than 10,000 lines from a natural-language specification or through interaction with a non-expert user, not counting code glued together from existing libraries. The deadline has not passed, so the forecast is recorded now and reviewed after 2029.
limitations: The live post notes a later clarification, with italics added in June 2024. This record quotes the post as it reads now.
No test procedure for 'reliably' and 'bug-free' is fixed yet.
